research_question: Does the frozen fixed-base-memory enrollment result replicate across previously unseen OTDR split seeds without changing the model, features, memory policy, supports, queries, or analysis targets?
matched_frozen_comparator: summary_only tabpfn_v2 on identical pair, split seed, support draw, and query cohorts
primary_replication_cohort: the 84 pair/seed units from split seeds 7, 123, 2026, and 31415, which had not been evaluated with fixed base memory when this protocol was frozen
secondary_combined_cohort: all 105 pair/seed units after adding the previously observed exploratory seed-42 cohort

success_criteria.primary_metric: harmonic mean of base-class and enrolled-fault accuracy

interpretation: This protocol was frozen after the seed-42 fixed-memory pilot. No hyperparameter, feature, context-size, support, query, or model selection is permitted from the new outer results. The four previously unseen split seeds form the replication cohort; seed 42 is included only in a separately labeled combined estimate.
